summary: Established an AIDE-based file integrity baseline for /etc on node1, verified detection works, and completed the mandatory single-node restart/recovery evidence cycle.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 (Ubuntu 24.04, sudo available), confirmed AIDE was not yet installed
Confirmed the default Ubuntu aide.conf.d/70_aide_etc rule (`/etc$ d VarDir`) recursively monitors all of /etc
Ran `aideinit -y -f` to build the baseline database at /var/lib/aide/aide.db (21.8MB, 87,362 entries under /etc)
Verified the baseline with `aide --check --limit='^/etc'` against the real config: no differences
Created a test file /etc/aide-integrity-test.txt and reran the check to prove AIDE detects and reports new/changed files under /etc (flagged as 'Added entries: 1')
Removed the test file and reran the check to confirm a clean baseline state again
Confirmed dailyaidecheck.timer is enabled and active for ongoing scheduled integrity reporting
Captured pre-restart boot_id and aide.db checksum, restarted node1 via `shutdown -r now`, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed (cf34dc87... -> 5baaec58...) and uptime reset
Post-restart: confirmed aide.db checksum unchanged, dailyaidecheck.timer active/enabled again, and a fresh scoped /etc check still reports NO differences with the same 87,362 entries

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline before restart (integrity DB present, timer active)
evidence.summary: Pre-restart: /etc baseline check clean (87,362 entries, no differences), dailyaidecheck.timer enabled/active, aide.db md5=131bb6e3edc2fcc6f165a53cf2073043, boot_id=cf34dc87-fdca-4c6a-80e1-579d5524a1da

evidence.requirement: Integrity baseline established for /etc and proven to detect changes
evidence.summary: AIDE installed, default config recursively covers /etc, aide.db initialized, check reports clean; a test file created under /etc was correctly flagged as an added entry, then confirmed clean again after removal
`shutdown -r now` issued in background via nohup; command acknowledged 'reboot command issued' before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Node restart proven via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Immediately after reboot command, node was unreachable (connection reset); polling succeeded shortly after with boot_id=5baaec58-15a1-4719-b22f-91a56e250d36 (changed from cf34dc87...) and uptime reset to 11:19:56

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of integrity baseline and required services
evidence.summary: After restart, aide.db checksum unchanged (131bb6e3edc2fcc6f165a53cf2073043), dailyaidecheck.timer active/enabled, and a fresh /etc-scoped integrity check reports NO differences across the same 87,362 entries
